<!--
Step 6 of the pipeline: adjust the predicted AC counts so they do not exceed the
number of housing units reported by the Census, at the tract, county, block group
and ZIP code (ZCTA) levels (proportional scaling, see Data/readme.md).

Run this after ACprob_to_county_zip.py.

Working directory: an .Rmd file uses the folder it lives in as the working
directory, so all files below are relative to this file's folder.

Inputs:
  nhgis_tr2020_tr2010.csv                       - NHGIS 2020 -> 2010 tract crosswalk (https://www.nhgis.org/geographic-crosswalks)
  results/FINALdata/summary_tract_{year}.csv     - tract AC summaries (ACprob_to_county_zip.py, step 4)
  results/FINALdata/summary_county_{year}.csv    - county AC summaries
  results/summary_grp_{year}.csv                 - block group AC summaries (ACprob_to_county_zip.py, step 1)
  results/FINALdata/summary_zcta_with_county_{year}.csv - ZCTA AC summaries (ACprob_to_county_zip.py, step 3)
  Totalhousing_{year}_zcta.csv                  - ZCTA-level total housing units downloaded from the Census Bureau
                                                  (last column = total units; NAME contains the 5-digit ZCTA)
  Housing-unit totals for tracts, counties and block groups are downloaded with tidycensus
  (requires a Census API key: https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html, then tidycensus::census_api_key()).
Outputs (results/FINALdata/):
  Totalhousing_2020.csv (in this folder), summary_{tract,county,grp,zcta}_adjusted_{year}.csv
-->

```{r}
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)  # dplyr, readr, tidyr, stringr

results_dir <- "./results"
final_dir <- "./results/FINALdata"

# 50 states + DC (the first 51 entries of tidycensus::fips_codes)
state_list <- unique(fips_codes$state)[1:51]

# Run a Census download for each state and stack the results.
# A state that fails is skipped (with a message) instead of stopping the loop.
download_by_state <- function(get_one_state) {
  result_list <- list()
  for (state_abbr in state_list) {
    message("Getting data for state: ", state_abbr)
    try({
      result_list[[state_abbr]] <- get_one_state(state_abbr)
    }, silent = TRUE)
  }
  bind_rows(result_list)
}

# Cap the predicted counts at the number of housing units in each area.
# If the predicted total is larger than the housing units, every AC type is
# scaled down by the same factor; otherwise the counts are kept.
adjust_to_housing <- function(df, id_col) {
  df %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
    mutate(
      total_predicted     = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
      scaling_factor      = if_else(total_predicted > total_units, total_units / total_predicted, 1),
      Adjusted_Count      = round(Count * scaling_factor),
      Adjusted_Percentage = round(100 * Adjusted_Count / sum(Adjusted_Count), 2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

# 1. Census tract level
```{r}
# 1a. Total housing units by tract, 2020 Decennial Census (H1_001N)
dc_2020_all <- download_by_state(function(state_abbr) {
  get_decennial(geography = "tract", variables = c(totalhouse = "H1_001N"),
                year = 2020, state = state_abbr, geometry = FALSE, cache_table = TRUE)
})
glimpse(dc_2020_all)

# 1b. Add the 2010 tract id (tr2010ge) with the NHGIS 2020 -> 2010 tract crosswalk,
#     so the 2010 and 2015 summaries (2010 tract boundaries) can be matched
tr2010 <- read.csv('./nhgis_tr2020_tr2010.csv')
tr2010$GEOID <- sprintf("%011s", tr2010$tr2020ge)

DC_2020_all <- left_join(dc_2020_all, tr2010) %>%
  select(-c("parea", "wt_pop", "wt_adult", "wt_fam", "wt_hh", "wt_hu", "wt_ownhu", "wt_renthu",
            "NAME", "variable", 'tr2010gj', 'tr2020gj', 'tr2020ge')) %>%
  rename(total_units = value)
write.csv(DC_2020_all, './Totalhousing_2020.csv', row.names = FALSE)

# 1c. Adjust the tract summaries
housing_units <- read_csv("./Totalhousing_2020.csv") %>%
  mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID), tr2010ge = as.character(tr2010ge)) %>%
  distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE)

adjust_tract_counts <- function(year) {
  df <- read_csv(file.path(final_dir, paste0("summary_tract_", year, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
  if ("GEOID10" %in% names(df)) df <- rename(df, GEOID = GEOID10)
  df <- df %>% mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) %>% distinct()

  # 2010 and 2015 use 2010 tract boundaries: join on the 2010 tract id
  if (year %in% c("2010", "2015")) {
    df <- df %>% left_join(housing_units %>% select(tr2010ge, total_units), by = c("GEOID" = "tr2010ge"))
  } else {
    df <- df %>% left_join(housing_units %>% select(GEOID, total_units), by = "GEOID")
  }

  adjusted <- df %>%
    mutate(GEOIDCN = str_sub(GEOID, 1, -7)) %>%   # county FIPS = GEOID without the 6 tract digits
    adjust_to_housing("GEOID") %>%
    select(GEOIDCN, GEOID, ACtype, Adjusted_Count, Adjusted_Percentage) %>%
    drop_na(GEOID)

  write_csv(adjusted, file.path(final_dir, paste0("summary_tract_adjusted_", year, ".csv")))
  adjusted
}

tract_adjusted <- lapply(c("2010", "2015", "2020"), adjust_tract_counts)
```

# 2. County level
```{r}
# Total housing units by county: 2020 Decennial Census (H1_001N), ACS 5-year (B25001_001) for other years
get_county_housing <- function(year) {
  download_by_state(function(state_abbr) {
    if (year == 2020) {
      get_decennial(geography = "county", variables = "H1_001N", year = 2020,
                    state = state_abbr, geometry = FALSE, cache_table = TRUE) %>%
        select(GEOID, total_units = value)
    } else {
      get_acs(geography = "county", variables = "B25001_001", year = year, survey = "acs5",
              state = state_abbr, geometry = FALSE, cache_table = TRUE) %>%
        select(GEOID, total_units = estimate)
    }
  }) %>%
    mutate(GEOID = sprintf("%05d", as.integer(GEOID))) %>%
    distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

adjust_county_counts <- function(year) {
  housing_data <- get_county_housing(as.integer(year))
  adjusted <- read_csv(file.path(final_dir, paste0("summary_county_", year, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(GEOID = sprintf("%05d", as.integer(GEOID))) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    left_join(housing_data %>% select(GEOID, total_units), by = "GEOID") %>%
    adjust_to_housing("GEOID") %>%
    select(GEOID, ACtype, Adjusted_Count, Adjusted_Percentage) %>%
    drop_na(GEOID)

  output_file <- file.path(final_dir, paste0("summary_county_adjusted_", year, ".csv"))
  write_csv(adjusted, output_file)
  message("Saved: ", output_file)
  adjusted
}

county_adjusted <- lapply(c("2010", "2015", "2020"), adjust_county_counts)
```

# 3. Block group level
```{r}
# Total housing units by block group: 2000 Decennial Census SF1 (H001001), ACS 5-year (B25001_001) for other years
get_blkgrp_housing <- function(year) {
  download_by_state(function(state_abbr) {
    if (year == 2000) {
      get_decennial(geography = "block group", variables = "H001001", year = 2000, state = state_abbr,
                    sumfile = "sf1", geometry = FALSE, cache_table = TRUE) %>%
        select(GEOID, total_units = value)
    } else {
      get_acs(geography = "block group", variables = "B25001_001", year = year, survey = "acs5",
              state = state_abbr, geometry = FALSE, cache_table = TRUE) %>%
        select(GEOID, total_units = estimate)
    }
  }) %>%
    mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) %>%
    distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

adjust_blkgrp_counts <- function(year) {
  housing_data <- get_blkgrp_housing(as.integer(year))
  df <- read_csv(file.path(results_dir, paste0("summary_grp_", year, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
  # Block group id column: STFID (2000) or GEOID10 (2010+)
  if ("STFID"   %in% names(df)) df <- rename(df, GEOID = STFID)
  if ("GEOID10" %in% names(df)) df <- rename(df, GEOID = GEOID10)

  adjusted <- df %>%
    mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    left_join(housing_data %>% select(GEOID, total_units), by = "GEOID") %>%
    adjust_to_housing("GEOID") %>%
    select(GEOID, ACtype, Adjusted_Count, Adjusted_Percentage) %>%
    drop_na(GEOID)

  output_file <- file.path(final_dir, paste0("summary_grp_adjusted_", year, ".csv"))
  write_csv(adjusted, output_file)
  message("Saved: ", output_file)
  adjusted
}

blkgrp_adjusted <- lapply(c("2000", "2010", "2015", "2020"), adjust_blkgrp_counts)
```

# 4. ZIP code (ZCTA) level
```{r}
# Housing-unit file for each boundary year (2015 uses the 2010 file)
zcta_housing_files <- c("2000" = "./Totalhousing_2000_zcta.csv",
                        "2010" = "./Totalhousing_2010_zcta.csv",
                        "2015" = "./Totalhousing_2010_zcta.csv",
                        "2020" = "./Totalhousing_2020_zcta.csv")

adjust_zcta_counts <- function(year) {
  prediction <- read_csv(file.path(final_dir, paste0("summary_zcta_with_county_", year, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(ZCTA = sprintf("%05s", as.character(ZCTA)))

  # Housing units: the last column is the total; the 5-digit ZCTA is taken from NAME
  housing_raw <- read_csv(zcta_housing_files[[year]], show_col_types = FALSE)
  housing <- housing_raw %>%
    rename(total_units = all_of(colnames(housing_raw)[ncol(housing_raw)])) %>%
    mutate(ZCTA = sprintf("%05s", str_extract(NAME, "\\d{5}"))) %>%
    distinct(ZCTA, total_units)

  adjusted <- prediction %>%
    left_join(housing, by = "ZCTA") %>%
    adjust_to_housing("ZCTA") %>%
    select(GEOID, ZCTA, ACtype, Adjusted_Count, Adjusted_Percentage) %>%
    drop_na(ZCTA)

  write_csv(adjusted, file.path(final_dir, paste0("summary_zcta_adjusted_", year, ".csv")))
  adjusted
}

zcta_adjusted <- lapply(c("2000", "2010", "2015", "2020"), adjust_zcta_counts)
```

# 5. Extra checks (not needed for the final data)
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# 5a. Predicted counts as a share of ACS households, 2010 tracts
acs_2010_all <- download_by_state(function(state_abbr) {
  get_acs(geography = "tract", variables = c(totalhouse = "B07013_001E"), year = 2010,
          survey = "acs5", state = state_abbr, geometry = FALSE, cache_table = TRUE)
})

df <- read_csv(file.path(final_dir, "summary_tract_2010.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
if ("GEOID10" %in% names(df)) df <- rename(df, GEOID = GEOID10)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID)) %>%
  left_join(acs_2010_all %>% select(GEOID, total_units = estimate), by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(weighted_count = Count,
         weighted_percentage = round(Count / total_units * 100, 2))
head(df)
write.csv(df, file.path(results_dir, "summary_tract_2010_weights.csv"))

# 5b. Total housing units by state (ACS 2022 5-year, B25136_001):
#     continental U.S. total and the excluded states/territories
acs_state <- get_acs(geography = "state", variables = "B25136_001E", year = 2022,
                     survey = "acs5", cache_table = TRUE)
non_conus <- c("Alaska", "Hawaii", "Puerto Rico", "American Samoa", "Guam",
               "Northern Mariana Islands", "U.S. Virgin Islands")
acs_conus <- acs_state %>% filter(!NAME %in% non_conus)
sum(acs_conus$estimate)
write.csv(acs_conus, "./acs2020_house_county.csv", row.names = FALSE)

acs_state %>% filter(NAME %in% c("Alaska", "Hawaii", "Puerto Rico"))
```
